charts.name: Saint Lucia reference chart of accounts
charts.legal_reference: This pack found no legal chart of accounts in Saint Lucia, and opened neither the Companies Act nor the Income Tax Act: no section of either is cited. What the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 15.42, asks of a taxable person is that tax invoices be issued (s. 34) and records kept. This chart is original: four digits, blocked so that each range reaches one line of a statement of financial position and an income statement presented in the manner of IFRS for SMEs, which is a choice of this pack and not a text the country imposes. The settlement account of the VAT return (2100, refundable 1172) is distinct from the accounts the tax posts to (2101, 2102 and 2103 collected, 1170 and 1171 recoverable). See README.md

numbering.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 15.42, s. 34 — tax invoices, and s. 35 — tax credit and debit notes. The Act, as read for this pack, does not say that the series of invoice numbers may have no gap, which is why `numbering` is `sequential` and not `gapless`; `number_format` is a convention this pack proposes. The particulars of a tax invoice are set by the Comptroller, not by the Act, and are not printed as mentions

payment_terms.legal_reference: No Saint Lucian text read for this pack sets a payment term between two businesses or a rate of interest on a commercial debt paid late: the interest of 1.25 % a month of s. 33 and the penalty of s. 47(4) are charges on the taxable person towards the Comptroller, not a term between two businesses. `legal_payment_days` and `late_payment_reference` are empty

tax_point.legal_reference: The time-of-supply rules of the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 15.42 (s. 18) were not applied in full for this pack: `earliest_of_delivery_or_payment` is the nearest value of the closed vocabulary to the usual rule (the earliest of delivery, invoice and payment) and is a convention to be checked against the Act by a reviewer

einvoicing.legal_reference: No Saint Lucian text read for this pack obliges a business to issue or accept an electronic invoice: the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 15.42, s. 34 asks for a tax invoice in the form the Comptroller specifies, without naming a platform, a format or a Peppol profile. No Peppol authority for Saint Lucia was looked for. `profile`, `party_scheme` and `vat_scheme` are null: there is no domestic profile to name

not_taxed.legal_reference: Not modelled, and not a finding that the service is untaxed. The Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 15.42, s. 9(1)(b) and (2)(c) charges tax on an import of services, payable by the recipient, with an import declaration and payment within twenty days after the tax period (s. 28). The pack carries no code for this self-assessment (the tax would be both collected and deducted, and the declaration line was not found): such a purchase is entered with LC-P-EX and the user, with their accountant, accounts for the tax outside the pack. See README.md
